title: Leeds YouTubers react as Farke agrees a new deal in principle
summary: Five directory channels react to the report (The Athletic, Fri 16 Oct 2026) that Daniel Farke and Leeds United have reached an agreement in principle on a new contract running to 2029. Paperwork is still to be finalised and signed; Leeds declined to comment and nothing is official yet. Farke's current deal expires next summer. Leeds are seventh, beaten once in six, before hosting Manchester United at Elland Road on Sunday 18 October (14:00 BST). In his pre-match press conference (BBC Sport) Farke defended Michael Carrick and quoted Elvis: 'a little less conversation, a little more action.'

title: Chelsea YouTubers react as Reece James faces three months out
summary: Six directory channels react to Reece James's knee surgery. Sky and BBC Sport report he is expected to be out for around three months. Xabi Alonso (BBC Sport): 'We won't set timelines... It's not going to be short. Whether it's before or after Christmas then time will tell.' Chelsea visit Everton on Saturday lunchtime.

title: United YouTubers react as Martinez apologises after his board outburst

After criticising Manchester United's hierarchy and technical director Jason Wilcox following the 2-0 Champions League defeat at Atletico Madrid (Tue 13 Oct 2026), Martinez issued a clarifying statement on Wednesday, then met Wilcox, CEO Omar Berrada and head coach Michael Carrick on Thursday 15 Oct and apologised for expressing himself 'at a time and place that perhaps were not the right ones'. BBC Sport understands he was fined; the club considers the matter closed. United (13th, six points from six league games) visit Leeds United on Sunday at 14:00 UK time; Carrick holds a press conference on Friday. Martinez's deal expires next summer with a 12-month club option undecided.
